title: Auto Server Names
description: Stop naming every server "A Minecraft Server". This mod auto fixes that.
body:
# Auto Minecraft Server Namer

Stop seeing generic server names like **"Minecraft Server"**.

Auto Minecraft Server Namer automatically generates clean, readable names from the server address you enter and can even rename your existing saved servers with a single click.

## Features

### 🔤 Automatic Server Naming
When adding a new server, the mod automatically generates a readable name from the server address.

**Examples:**

| Server Address | Generated Name |
|---------------|----------------|
| `play.minemalia.net` | `Minemalia` |
| `nightlight-smp.play.hosting` | `Night Light SMP` |
| `pvpserver.aternos.me` | `PVP Server` |
| `mc.hypixel.net` | `Hypixel` |

### 🖱️ Assign Names Button
Adds an **Assign Names** button directly to the Multiplayer screen.

With a single click, the mod:

- Scans your saved servers
- Finds servers with generic names such as:
  - `Minecraft Server`
  - `A Minecraft Server`
  - Empty names
- Generates proper names from their IP/domain
- Renames them automatically
- Saves the updated server list

No more manually renaming dozens of servers.

### ⚡ Real-Time Detection
- Works while typing a server address
- Works when pasting a server address
- Instantly suggests a readable server name

### 🛡️ Smart Protection
- Never overwrites manually edited server names
- Skips numeric IP addresses
- Detects duplicate names
- Automatically adds suffixes like:
  - `Minemalia`
  - `Minemalia (2)`
  - `Minemalia (3)`

### 🧠 Intelligent Name Generation
The mod cleans up server addresses by:

- Removing common prefixes:
  - `play`
  - `mc`
  - `join`
  - `hub`

- Converting:
  - `nightlight-smp`
  - into
  - `Night Light SMP`

- Preserving common Minecraft terms:
  - SMP
  - PVP
  - UHC
  - RPG
  - MMO
  - OP
  - FFA

## 📦 Supported Versions

- Minecraft 1.20.x
- Minecraft 1.21.x

## 🔧 Mod Loader

- Fabric

## 🚀 Technical Details

- Client-side only
- Java 21
- Lightweight and fast
- No external APIs
- No internet requests
- No telemetry
- Works completely offline

## Why Use This Mod?

Minecraft already knows the server address.

Auto Minecraft Server Namer makes sure the server name looks just as clean.
